title: Unique Velvety Croatian Lamb Kebabs
description: Rich and festive Croatian dish featuring lamb, olive oil, and a yakimono-grill, suitable for diabetic diets.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono-grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Brush the kebabs with lemon juice during the last minute of grilling.
Remove the kebabs from the grill and garnish with chopped parsley.
Serve the kebabs hot, with your choice of sides, such as roasted vegetables or quinoa.
